notes: The Rp169.3 billion TJSL figure (E5) covers environmental and infrastructure programs as well as social ones; no amount is broken out for education or MSME training. E6 is part of the TJSL program, so it is cited only for Cross-cultural, not Community, to avoid double counting. The filing gives two different figures for women in management: 23.2% of Group managerial positions (ESG section) and approximately 35.05% of managerial roles (human capital section); 45.44% of the workforce and 64.7% of new hires are women. These are demographics only and were not scored. LinkAja (E10) is run by Finarya, in which Telkomsel holds only a 24.8% equity interest. MDI Ventures (E12) states its objective as financial returns and strategic value for Telkom. Film production under Nuon's digital lifestyle segment is mentioned in a sentence split by a line break and was not recorded separately. The creative businesses sit in the Other (Non-Core) segment, and their revenue is not disclosed. Item 5 mentions higher revenue from 'digital education ecosystems' and 'online gaming' but does not quantify them. USO payments are a mandatory regulatory contribution and were not scored. The Telkom Hub (2018) and the Cakap collaboration (2023) appear only as historical milestones and were not scored. FLOU Cloud, MyIndibiz and SME Wi-Fi services were treated as serving small-business customers rather than enabling them. The filing reports one work-related fatality in 2025 and says all whistleblowing reports were addressed, but it discloses no substantiated discrimination or harassment cases.
